Messages.Author: Soonerborn
Messages.Body:
Marie Faucigny's special text reads, " Non-weapon equipment cards cost her 1 less blood or pool to equip."

Pier 13 reads, "During your influence phase, this minion may equip with a non-location, non-unique equipment card from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). This is not an action and cannot be blocked."

Just want to confirm that any (non-unique, non-location, non-weapon) equipment Marie equips via Pier 13 is subject to the reduced cost, correct?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Soonerborn wrote:
> Just want to confirm that any (non-unique, non-location, non-weapon) equipment Marie equips via Pier 13 is subject to the reduced cost, correct
>
Yes. This was confirmed in RTR 7-7-7, which reversed a string of earlier rulings.

thelasombra.com/rules/RTR7-7-7.txt
>
> RTR wrote:
> All cost-affecting cards operate no matter how the card is played ("as normal" or otherwise). All multiplication and division is handled first, followed by
> addition and subtraction.
>
Pier 13 says equip, Marie says equip, it doesn't matter that it's being played in a non-standard way. Done.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
And as you may have noticed, the both Marie and Pier 13 used the verb "equip" anyway.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
